description:
Make the archive planner resolve every pinned document through one module object reader on the invocation's selected code checkout, instead of three processes per document through the revision resolver bridge.

## Background

- `plan_archive_target` (`crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs:184-309`) builds `GitRevisionResolver::new(repo_root)` (`crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs:190`), a bridge onto the git module with the default executable that ignores the invocation's checkout.
- `inventory_issues_pinned_evidence` (`crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs:90-105`), called once at `crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs:248`, calls `read_pinned_path` for each pinned request, three git processes each (resolve, blob id, blob), and keeps only the resolved version: `Resolved(version)` on success, `Unavailable` otherwise.
- The in-process test fixture `executor` (`crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs:892-896`) builds executors without paths.
- Archive preview CLI tests: `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/archive_preview_cli_tests.rs:339` onwards.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The planner takes the selected code checkout from the executor's paths (`code_checkout()`), and its in-process test fixture supplies detected paths. It resolves each unchanged original revision expression through the shared reader commit-resolution operation, peels only its canonical object ID when necessary, and requests `<canonical-commit>:<path>` in the same child. No consumer-local resolver is introduced.
- [hard] REQ-02: Evidence is `Resolved(version)` exactly when the path names a file at the resolved commit, and `Unavailable` otherwise, including without a git checkout; `commands/archive.rs` no longer names `GitRevisionResolver`.
- [hard] REQ-03: A CLI test previews archives over one and over several pinned documents with the counting stand-in first on `PATH`, and asserts that both record the same number of git invocations; today's planner adds three per pinned document, so it fails.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Archive planning reads pinned evidence through one git process
